customer_message.subject: Mould behind the wardrobe and boiler failures – Obere Gasse 63
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I rent a 4.5-room flat at Obere Gasse 63 in Emmen, managed by Verwaltung Emme & Söhne.

There is mould growing behind the wardrobe in our bedroom, and it is now spreading along the bedroom ceiling. In addition, the boiler cuts out at night, so the bedrooms are cold in the morning. The heating clearly does not work as it should.

My partner sleeps nearest the wall where the mould is worst. She has had a cough since July that will not go, and her doctor asked her straight away whether there was mould where she sleeps.

The management says the mould is just condensation from the cold nights and will go once the boiler is fixed. I am not convinced and would like an expert to establish why the wall is damp before they just paint over it.

To be clear, I do not intend to withhold my rent or pay it into any deposit account; I have always paid on time and want to continue doing so. I simply want the defects repaired properly. How can you help?

Kind regards,
Beatrix Lindqvist
